summary.headline: Remote device retirement guidance is added amid endpoint-management updates
summary.overview: The April 2 documentation set introduces a dedicated Intune remote device action for retiring devices, alongside updates to device query and in-development references covering Endpoint Privilege Management and Security Copilot.
summary.adminImpact: Endpoint operations teams should compare the new retire-action guidance with their offboarding procedures and confirm when to use retire versus other device actions. Analytics owners should also review the updated device-query reference.

keyChanges.title: Remote Device Action: Retire guidance is added
keyChanges.detail: Microsoft published Intune documentation for retiring a device through a remote device action.

keyChanges.title: Device Query reference is updated
keyChanges.detail: The Intune Advanced Analytics documentation for device query was revised.

summary.headline: Security baseline, TeamViewer integration, and Autopilot hybrid proxy documentation change
summary.overview: Updates include Intune security baseline material, a new TeamViewer integration article, the Windows Autopilot hybrid connector proxy, and Configuration Manager infrastructure upgrade guidance.
summary.adminImpact: Review baseline references before policy changes, assess the new TeamViewer integration material if that remote-support tool is in scope, and validate proxy or upgrade runbooks against the refreshed Autopilot and Configuration Manager guidance.

keyChanges.title: TeamViewer integration guidance is added
keyChanges.detail: Microsoft added documentation for using the TeamViewer integration in Microsoft Intune.

keyChanges.title: Security baseline references are updated
keyChanges.detail: The Intune MDM security baseline settings reference was updated.

keyChanges.title: Autopilot hybrid connector proxy guidance is refreshed
keyChanges.detail: Microsoft updated the Windows Autopilot hybrid connector proxy documentation.

summary.headline: Endpoint security, app protection, and Autopilot Reset references receive broad updates
summary.overview: A high-volume documentation refresh spans endpoint-security device management, app protection policy, Autopilot Reset, Configuration Manager remote actions, and Remote Assist.
summary.adminImpact: Use the refreshed references to validate endpoint-security and app-protection implementation guidance. Organizations relying on Autopilot Reset, co-management remote actions, or Remote Help should review their runbooks for documentation changes.

keyChanges.title: Endpoint security device-management guidance is updated
keyChanges.detail: Microsoft updated the Intune reference for managing devices with endpoint security.

keyChanges.title: App protection policy guidance is refreshed
keyChanges.detail: The Intune app protection policy documentation was updated.

keyChanges.title: Autopilot Reset overview is updated
keyChanges.detail: Microsoft revised the Windows Autopilot Reset overview.

summary.headline: Derived credentials guidance is added as device-management documentation is refreshed
summary.overview: The day introduces Intune guidance for derived credentials on mobile devices and includes broad updates across Configuration Manager, existing-device Autopilot, Remote Help deployment, and device scopes.
summary.adminImpact: Mobile security teams considering derived credentials should evaluate the new Intune guidance. Endpoint teams should also verify Autopilot existing-device and Remote Help deployment procedures against the refreshed documentation.

keyChanges.title: Derived credentials guidance for mobile devices is added
keyChanges.detail: Microsoft published documentation for using derived credentials for mobile devices with Intune.

keyChanges.title: Autopilot existing-device guidance is updated
keyChanges.detail: The Windows Autopilot documentation for existing devices was revised.

keyChanges.title: Remote Help deployment guidance is updated
keyChanges.detail: Microsoft refreshed the Intune documentation for deploying Remote Help.

summary.headline: Mobile threat defense and Windows enrollment guides are added in a large documentation release
summary.overview: The archive records a very large documentation change set, including new end-user instructions for installing a mobile threat defense app and a new Windows device enrollment guide, with related updates for Autopilot enrollment and Remote Help deployment.
summary.adminImpact: Review the new threat-defense and Windows enrollment material before updating onboarding guidance. Co-management and remote-support owners should revalidate Autopilot enrollment and Remote Help deployment documentation used in operations.

keyChanges.title: Mobile threat defense installation guidance is added
keyChanges.detail: Microsoft added end-user documentation for installing a mobile threat defense app on a mobile device.

keyChanges.title: Windows device enrollment guide is added
keyChanges.detail: A new Microsoft Intune guide for Windows device enrollment was published.

keyChanges.title: Remote Help deployment guidance is updated
keyChanges.detail: The Intune documentation for deploying Remote Help was revised.
